subcases.title: active before dispatcher order: skill-policy 在 safe-edit gate 之前先执行
subcases.preconditions: active runtime + 未认证 session + 在 skill-policy 之前没有其他 plugin 放行 safe_edit
subcases.inject: 在 handler chain trace 中观察 before 顺序: skill-policy → safe-edit-gate → executor
subcases.oracle: ORA-PT-12: skill-policy 在所有写工具 gate 之前 (handler order 锁定)

subcases.title: DB state missing: 未 attest → 触发专用 rule (hard_block)
subcases.preconditions: DB 干净,没有任何 state row;session 未调过 attestSkillRead
subcases.inject: 清空 skill_attest_state 表,验证 state missing 分支
subcases.oracle: ORA-PT-12: 专用 rule (skill-read-attest-required) 抛出,executor entry=0

subcases.title: DB state invalid: attest:false (identity 不匹配) → 触发专用 rule
subcases.preconditions: DB 存在 stale row (旧 session);当前 session identity 不匹配
subcases.inject: 保留旧 row,换 session 调用写工具,验证 state invalid 分支
subcases.oracle: ORA-PT-12: 专用 rule 抛出 (state_written=false 走 fail-closed),executor entry=0

subcases.oracle: ORA-PT-12: executor boundary counter=0,目标文件未变

subcases.title: safe_framework_edit 被 dispatcher 拒绝 (executor counter=0)
subcases.preconditions: 未认证 session + DB state invalid
subcases.inject: 调用 safe_framework_edit 'update .opencode/plugin',观察 executor 边界计数器
subcases.oracle: ORA-PT-12: executor boundary counter=0,framework 文件未变

subcases.title: dispatch_subagent 被 dispatcher 拒绝 (executor counter=0)
subcases.preconditions: 未认证 session + DB state invalid
subcases.inject: 调用 dispatch_subagent 'spawn child agent',观察 executor 边界计数器 + 子 session 创建计数
subcases.oracle: ORA-PT-12: executor boundary counter=0,子 session 未创建,root session 状态不变
